fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x444AB0 (VMCombatRegistrationSystem::Update): for each removed combat, InternalGetCombatObject is collected into a Noesis collection and RemoveCombatObject is called; then for every collected object a new entity is created (EntityCommandBuffer::CreateEntity) and the component's pointer is set to the object with AddRef (vtbl+0x18 of the object's +0x10 base) / Release (+0x20) of the old value (lines ~224-227). Value type Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMCombat> (the Data singleton's value type), written as void*. Live: 48 instances, all heap pointers.

summary: One-frame event on a fresh entity: carries the gui::VMCombat view-model object that was just removed from VMCombatDataSingletonComponent, so UI code can drop it (seen in fights, deaths, dialogues and spell casts, i.e. whenever combat entities go away).
open_questions: Holds a Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMCombat>; exposed as an opaque pointer.
